name: Yazawa Ryuusuke
source:
The protagonist’s friend and a fellow university student in the same year. Because he spent one year preparing for entrance exams, he is one year older.
A great punk fan, his everyday fashion is also quite tough-looking.
He belongs to a band club and plays bass.
Combined with his manner of speaking, he can look like a bad person at first glance, but he has been dating the girlfriend he made in high school all this time, and in order not to burden his poor family with many siblings, he studied desperately and passed a national public university—his inner self is actually the complete opposite of a “bad guy.” 

[Translated from the [url=https://c142.net/main/fireworks/character.html]official website[/url]]
